hard_boundaries: merge or release is not deployment
live use is not a transaction
settlement or finality is not proof of delivery or acceptance
name: Institutional Financial Rail Evidence State Model

orthogonal_states.market_effect: UNMEASURED unless separately evidenced; no price or market reaction is implied by a rail transition.
orthogonal_states.regulatory_action: Registration, exemption, approval, consultation, order or enforcement is recorded independently from operational maturity.

states.meaning: Named in the bounded catalogue. Nothing else is inferred.
A proposal, consultation, announced integration, or stated intent exists.
Relevant implementation code exists. Merge, release, deployment and use remain separate.
Canonical code was merged or a release was published. Deployment is not inferred.
Named network, contract, participant or launch configuration is evidenced.
Infrastructure is evidenced in the target environment. General availability is not inferred.
The rail or product is evidenced as available for use. Transaction activity is not inferred.
At least one transaction is evidenced. Settlement is not inferred.
Settlement completion is evidenced for the bounded event. Legal finality is not inferred.
A legal or operational finality basis is evidenced for the bounded event.
